Official Announcement

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM)

hereby announces the
Final Merit List
following
completion of the appeals process.

The final merit list is displayed for the information of all
concerned and can be viewed through the following link.

View the final merit list following completion of the appeals process.

View Final Merit List (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/merit/SHUeMKa5vFmftqtKeByxtmDlkFEGJdMu64lWMY50Kcb3Rpao)

Demonstration & Interview Schedule

The
demonstration and interview before the Selection
Committee
shall be conducted as per the following schedule:

Schedule Details

Date

September 18, 2026

Reporting Time

10:30 AM

Venue

Conference Room, Administration Block, Garden Campus,
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Important Instructions

This is the
final merit list
following completion
of the appeals process.

The candidature of an applicant may be cancelled if any document
or information submitted by the applicant is found to be

fake, bogus, tampered with, or altered
.

Where an applicant has been declared

conditionally eligible
, their engagement or
inclusion in the further process shall be subject to fulfillment
of the required deficiency.

Applicants must bring their
original documents

and
NOC, where applicable
, in the case of
applicants serving through proper channel.

All applicants are required to prepare a

topic of their choice for a 5-minute demonstration
,
followed by an interview before the Selection Committee.

No TA/DA shall be admissible
for participation
in the further process.

Important Notice:

All concerned applicants are advised to carefully note the above
schedule and instructions and ensure their presence accordingly.

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
